# CarboniteLint v0.1.1 - Table of Contents

Static analysis that detects bare Ecto mutations on Carbonite-tracked tables missing audit transactions. Catches the gap between adding a trigger and updating all write paths.

## Pages

- [CarboniteLint](https://carbonite-lint.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Changelog](https://carbonite-lint.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- [CarboniteLint](https://carbonite-lint.hexdocs.pm/CarboniteLint.md): Static analysis that detects bare Ecto mutations on Carbonite-tracked tables
missing audit transactions.
- [CarboniteLint.Violation](https://carbonite-lint.hexdocs.pm/CarboniteLint.Violation.md): Represents a bare Ecto mutation on a Carbonite-tracked table without an audit
transaction.

- Exceptions
  - [CarboniteLint.AuditViolationError](https://carbonite-lint.hexdocs.pm/CarboniteLint.AuditViolationError.md): Raised by `CarboniteLint.with_enforcement/2` when a mutation on a
Carbonite-tracked table is attempted without a prior audit transaction.
